name: Skyline Masjid
summary: Two prayer halls and unequal minarets interlock into one long, low mosque panorama.
why: A shallow dome, a flat-roofed hall, stepped roofs, and two different tower heights form a continuous band. The deliberately wide silhouette feels almost like a wordmark, connecting distinct places of prayer into the rhythm of a city.
risk: Its unusually horizontal profile occupies less height inside a square app icon. At 24 pixels the panorama reads as a connected mosque skyline while individual entrances simplify.
sub1: Many places of prayer, one daily rhythm
reasonToChoose: The mosque should feel present in the rhythm of the city.
